p01.reason: It denies rule A by naming its own term, the winning file, with 'any more', and new.md nowhere tells its reader what a winning file was.

p02.reason: It excuses the reader from rule A's requirement that a project file hold every personal setting such as the editor and colour theme, a requirement new.md never states.

p03.reason: It denies rule A's behaviour that a project file causes the user and system files to be ignored, which new.md never describes, so it is not a plain guarantee.

p04.reason: It sets layer-based precedence against precedence by file modification time, an alternative neither old.md nor new.md presents.

p05.reason: It sets the single merged table against a separate copy per layer, an alternative neither document presents; rule A gave plugins one winning file, not per-layer copies.

p06.licence: Some tools combine lists by concatenating the values from every layer.
p06.reason: It denies list concatenation, which new.md introduced to its reader in the sentence just before it.

p07.licence: Several tools look for a dotfile in every parent directory up to the filesystem root.
p07.reason: It contrasts tern's search with the walk to the filesystem root that new.md described in the sentence just before it.

p08.licence: Some operators expect an environment variable to beat a flag, because the variable is often set by the deployment.
p08.reason: It denies the expectation that a variable beats a flag, which new.md stated in the preceding sentence.

p09.reason: It states what happens when a layer's file is absent, a guarantee that sets the design against no other rule and touches nothing of rule A.

p10.reason: It states a prohibition a user relies on, that loading never writes to a configuration file, without setting it against any design or rule A.
